policy: A radar trigger reopens the relevant research domain before a fresh authority or completeness claim. Very-high and high-drift sources are proactively watched; model memory never substitutes for a freshness check when the source can materially change UI authority, platform behavior, accessibility, AI agency, safety, or design-system guidance.

watch.trigger: draft milestone, conformance model, scope, outcome, or maturity changes
watch.reason: non-final high-impact accessibility specification

watch.trigger: registry status, symbol mapping, or WAI-Adapt integration changes
watch.reason: AAC semantic personalization remains evolving

watch.trigger: specification status, semantic mapping, personalization model, or user-agent support changes
watch.reason: high-drift accessibility personalization work can change AAC and cognitive-accessibility obligations

watch.trigger: DIS ballot result, publication, scope, or presentation requirement changes
watch.reason: sign-language presentation standard is still under development

watch.trigger: FDIS approval, publication, replacement of ISO 9241-13, or scope changes
watch.reason: user-assistance standard is in final-draft lifecycle

watch.trigger: committee-draft stage, intelligent-system categories, adaptation, agent, robot, or ambient-system guidance changes
watch.reason: emerging intelligent-system HCI guidance can alter multiple routing boundaries

watch.trigger: emotion-annotation draft status, representation model, modality, timestamp, or confidence semantics change
watch.reason: affective-computing standards remain very high drift

watch.trigger: committee-draft stage, DIS registration, multimodal reference architecture, interoperability, usability, or customer-service interaction requirements change
watch.reason: multimodal customer-service UI standard is under development and can alter cross-device and modality composition

watch.trigger: BCI data format revision, new normative metadata, provenance, signal, interoperability, or interface implications
watch.reason: brain-computer interface standardization is young and can change neuroinput evidence contracts

watch.trigger: BCI use-case revision, new safety context, industrial-control scope, smart-environment scope, or successor publication
watch.reason: BCI application boundaries can alter routing between medical, control, ambient, and modality faculties

watch.trigger: amendment, replacement edition, stability-date change, safety scope, essential-performance, or human-interface implications
watch.reason: patient-interacting rehabilitation robotics is safety critical and composes medical, robotics, accessibility, and physical-interaction obligations

watch.trigger: avatar-series revision, new part, identity, embodiment, ethical, accessibility, or AI-controller guidance changes
watch.reason: avatar and embodied-representation standards are new and may change identity or agency obligations

watch.trigger: revision, corrigendum, new cross-device input-action guidance, or platform adoption changes
watch.reason: cross-device action equivalence is a recent interaction standard

watch.trigger: AAC technical-specification revision, new device-consistency guidance, or successor standard
watch.reason: AAC ICT guidance is recent and directly affects communication-interface obligations

watch.trigger: stable release or locale-data model change
watch.reason: localization data changes continuously

watch.trigger: new generative-AI interaction, refinement, disclosure, correction, model-output, or platform guidance
watch.reason: high-drift AI platform behavior

watch.trigger: input, comfort, spatial layout, immersive media, accessibility, window, volume, or immersive-space guidance changes
watch.reason: rapidly evolving spatial UI

watch.trigger: foundational design-principle, hierarchy, materials, navigation, accessibility, or platform-convergence changes
watch.reason: authoritative Apple design guidance can alter platform-fit expectations

watch.trigger: keyboard navigation, shortcut, focus, command, or hardware-key guidance changes
watch.reason: desktop and power-user input guidance can change modality obligations

watch.trigger: material, legibility, layering, contrast, navigation, or component guidance changes
watch.reason: current Apple visual-system guidance is high drift and must remain contextual rather than universal

watch.trigger: windowing, menu, toolbar, sidebar, command, multitasking, or accessibility convention changes
watch.reason: desktop platform conventions evolve independently of web patterns

watch.trigger: stable component, motion, state, typography, layout, or expressive-system changes
watch.reason: current Android design-system evolution

watch.trigger: driver-distraction, template, quality, task-limit, parked-versus-driving, or input changes
watch.reason: safety-sensitive platform rules

watch.trigger: window-size, foldable, posture, adaptive-navigation, continuity, or large-screen guidance changes
watch.reason: large-screen and foldable behavior remains high drift

watch.trigger: glanceability, tiles, complications, navigation, input, or wearable accessibility guidance changes
watch.reason: wearable interaction conventions evolve with device and platform releases

watch.trigger: spec version, schema, transport, security, component vocabulary, action binding, or conformance changes
watch.reason: very-high-drift generative UI standard

watch.trigger: generative-UI protocol, declarative tree, component vocabulary, data binding, action authority, transport, or security model changes
watch.reason: very-high-drift generated-interface behavior can change the boundary between rendering and privileged action

watch.trigger: new or final guidance, submission expectations, use-related risk, critical-task, validation, or safety-communication changes
watch.reason: regulatory impact on medical UI

watch.trigger: new advisory circular, certification policy, automation, alerting, flightcrew-error, display/control, or workload guidance
watch.reason: safety-critical aviation certification guidance

watch.trigger: Core Web Vitals metric, threshold, responsiveness, interaction, or measurement changes
watch.reason: performance UX metrics evolve

watch.trigger: token, component, content, accessibility, or interaction-pattern changes
watch.reason: mature enterprise design-system guidance can inform reusable component and content heuristics

watch.trigger: token, component, accessibility, data-visualization, or enterprise-pattern changes
watch.reason: mature enterprise design-system guidance can alter implementation heuristics

watch.trigger: token, component, platform, accessibility, motion, or interaction guidance changes
watch.reason: mature cross-platform design-system guidance is actively maintained

watch.trigger: component, token, accessibility, navigation, form, or developer-tool pattern changes
watch.reason: mature product design-system guidance can refine implementation heuristics without overriding higher authority
